info.title: CoSens RSI Workflow API
info.description: CoSens RSI HTTP routes plus mounted private Memory routes. Authentication, dynamic dict fields, lifecycle semantics and MCP are specified in API.md. Generated from the current implementation without changing runtime routes.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_prepare_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Start or prepare an RSI task. RSI selects its Recipe and calls Friday Memory internally.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_request_guidance
x-mcp-tools.description:
Get RSI guidance or rank 1..8 candidate strategies using verified experience.

    Candidates contain id, version, description, confidence [0,1], cost [0,1].
    Bind guided decisions to the issued node_id. Record actual actions through
    checkpoint or submit_step; an advisory recommendation is not an execution.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_checkpoint
x-mcp-tools.description:
Save task progress; for assist decisions include decision_id, actual_action_id and next_state.

    Actual-action experiences are written internally to Friday Memory as pending.
    Neither checkpoint fields nor user feedback can supply verified rewards.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_next_step
x-mcp-tools.description: Get the next frozen hierarchical step for a guided RSI Run.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_store_artifact
x-mcp-tools.description: Store a text deliverable in RSI and return an immutable artifact reference.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_submit_step
x-mcp-tools.description: Submit a guided step's outputs against the server-issued attempt token and frozen contract.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_get_decision
x-mcp-tools.description: Read an RSI decision, actual action and internal Memory writeback status.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_complete_run
x-mcp-tools.description: Complete a guided RSI Run after all DAG nodes pass their output contracts.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_submit_result
x-mcp-tools.description: Submit the task result. External Codex results are recorded as unverified/inconclusive.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_get_run
x-mcp-tools.description: Read an existing RSI Run without performing another Memory search.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_get_active_recipe
x-mcp-tools.description: Read the active hierarchical RSI recipe for a task family.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_record_feedback
x-mcp-tools.description: Record user feedback against an existing Run; this does not directly modify shared Memory.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_start_improvement
x-mcp-tools.description:
Request a harness improvement job; reuse request_key for retries.

    The default key deduplicates the same run/reason. Use a new explicit key
    for a new experiment. Publication is a separate administrator action.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_get_improvement
x-mcp-tools.description: Read harness diagnosis, frozen comparison evidence and improvement status.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_capture_session_events
x-mcp-tools.description:
Durably append observable session events; stable IDs deduplicate retries.

    This does not attest complete action telemetry or verified expert authority.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_supply_initial_inputs
x-mcp-tools.description:
Supply missing original materials by immutable artifact ID before task inputs freeze.

    Late materials are labelled supplemented; existing executed inputs cannot
    be overwritten. Store artifacts first with cosens_store_artifact.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_resume_improvement
x-mcp-tools.description:
Resume waiting generic preparation after supplying inputs or a global runner.

    Running/unknown external executions require inspection and cannot be retried
    through this tool. New tasks and feedback also wake waiting jobs.

x-mcp-tools.name: cosens_get_run_events
x-mcp-tools.description: List persisted RSI lifecycle events for a Run.
